octum.title: Play Octum Online - Catch Bubbles & Match Colors
octum.slogan: Catch the bubbles on the right color!
octum.description: Octum is a fun and addictive color-matching game where you catch bubbles to match the correct colors. With its simple yet challenging gameplay, Octum is perfect for players of all ages. Experience the thrill of matching colors and improving your reflexes. Play Octum now and see how high you can score!

HomeIframe.title: Octum - Catch the Bubbles
HomeIframe.description: Join the fun and catch the bubbles in Octum! Match the colors and enjoy the exciting gameplay.

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Octum is a color-matching game where players catch bubbles to match the correct colors. It's a simple yet challenging game that tests your reflexes and color recognition skills.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Catch the bubbles that match the target color.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Avoid bubbles that don't match the target color.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Score points by successfully matching colors and see how high you can go!
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Match the colors of the bubbles to the target color.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Test your reflexes as you catch the right bubbles.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Easy to play but hard to master, Octum is fun for all ages.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Earn points by matching colors and aim for the high score!
